from PIL import Image

from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
orig=np.asarray(Image.open('inputs/01-revision_target.png').convert('RGB'),dtype=float)
g=np.asarray(Image.open('outputs/v1/intermediate/imagegen-edit-source.png').convert('RGB').resize((928,1152),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS),dtype=float)
